items.headline: New UK licensing rules for Botox and filler practitioners land this month
items.summary: From July 2026, anyone performing injectables needs to be registered, accredited and working within a clear risk framework. If you're a clinic owner, this is the moment to get your paperwork and qualifications in order rather than scramble later. I'd rather you hear it from me now than from a client asking awkward questions.

items.headline: Botox and fillers officially sit in the 'amber' risk category
items.summary: Government guidance now splits procedures into red, amber and green by risk. Botox and dermal fillers are amber, meaning a non-medical practitioner can only offer them under oversight from a named, regulated healthcare professional. Worth knowing exactly where you sit before a client asks.

items.headline: Clients are asking for quality over quantity in 2026
items.summary: The volume-heavy years feel like they're winding down. Practitioners are reporting clients asking for firmness and longevity rather than more product, with treatments built around skin health first. A useful line for your own content this month: less filler, more foundation.

items.headline: 'Prejuvenation' is bringing in a younger client base
items.summary: Clients in their twenties and thirties are booking in earlier, pairing light-touch neuromodulator work with preventative skincare and laser treatments rather than waiting for lines to set in. If your books have gone quiet, this is a group worth speaking to directly.

items.headline: Injectable skin boosters are having a real moment
items.summary: Hyaluronic acid delivered straight into the dermis is proving popular with clients who want results without committing to a full skincare routine. It's an easy upsell conversation if you already offer it, and an easy add if you don't.

items.headline: The injectables market keeps climbing
items.summary: Global aesthetic injectables are valued at over $11 billion this year and are forecast to more than double by 2033. The demand is there. The clinics that keep showing up consistently online are the ones who'll take the biggest share of it.
